title: A value compared period by period: the change and the change in percent, and the biggest moves
about: A total month over month, quarter over quarter or week over week: one row per period in order, each with its value, its change from the period before and that change in percent (signed, coloured, with bars), the biggest gain and the biggest drop as big numbers, a bar chart of the value per period (with a second value beside it), and the table as a CSV to download. Rows that are one per period already (a month column): give PERIOD and ORDER BY. Rows to add up per period: PERIOD date_trunc('month', day), VALUE SUM(amount), GROUP BY date_trunc('month', day).

period.about: the column (or SQL expression) naming each period: a month name, 'YYYY-MM', a date

value.about: the value per period: a column, or an aggregate such as SUM(amount) with group

compare.about: a second value per period drawn beside it in the chart (costs against revenue), as VALUE is: a column, or an aggregate with group

compareLabel.about: what the second value is (named in the chart's legend)

group.about: the SQL to group rows by, when the value adds rows up (usually the same as period)

order.about: the SQL that puts the periods in time order, oldest first (a month name needs a CASE; a date or 'YYYY-MM' sorts as it is)

periodLabel.about: what a period is called, for the first column

format.about: how values read: number or money

where.about: an SQL condition on the rows

file.about: the name of the CSV download

chart.about: bars (the value per period, and the second value beside it) or none

data.{{key}}: SELECT {{period}} AS p, {{value}} AS v, {{compare}} AS c, {{order}} AS o FROM {{table}}{{where|pre: WHERE }}{{group|pre: GROUP BY }} LIMIT 500

let.{{key}}_rows: =(() => { const day = (p) => /^\d{4}-\d{2}(-\d{2})?/.test(String(p ?? '')); const firsts = {{key}}.every(r => !day(r.p) || /^\d{4}-\d{2}(-01)?(\b|T|$)/.test(String(r.p))); const name = (p) => p == null || p === '' ? '—' : day(p) ? new Date(String(p).slice(0, 7) + (firsts ? '-01' : String(p).slice(7, 10)) + 'T00:00:00Z').toLocaleDateString(undefined, firsts ? { month: 'short', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' } : { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' }) : String(p); const key = (r) => typeof r.o === 'number' ? r.o : Number.isFinite(Number(r.o)) && String(r.o).trim() !== '' ? Number(r.o) : String(r.o ?? ''); const sorted = {{key}}.slice().sort((a, b) => { const x = key(a), y = key(b); return x < y ? -1 : x > y ? 1 : 0; }).slice(-Number({{last|json}}) || -24); return sorted.map((r, i, all) => { const v = Number(r.v) || 0; const prev = i ? Number(all[i - 1].v) || 0 : null; return { period: name(r.p), prior: i ? name(all[i - 1].p) : '', value: v, compare: r.c == null ? null : Number(r.c) || 0, change: prev === null ? null : v - prev, pct: prev ? Math.round((v - prev) / Math.abs(prev) * 1000) / 10 : null }; }); })()

card.text: ='Change is each ' + String({{periodLabel|json}}).toLowerCase() + '’s ' + String({{label|json}}).toLowerCase() + ' minus the one before it, and Change % is that change as a share of the one before. The first ' + String({{periodLabel|json}}).toLowerCase() + ' has nothing before it, so its change is n/a.'

card.do: =() => app.download({{file|json}}, app.csv({{key}}_rows, [{key: 'period', label: {{periodLabel|json}}}, {key: 'value', label: {{label|json}}}, {key: 'change', label: 'Change'}, {key: 'pct', label: 'Change %'}]))
